description: This script prepares a binary file by creating a header with specified addresses and appending the file's contents, effectively creating a customized headered binary output.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, interpreting the string as a number in any base (0x for hex, 0 for octal, etc.).

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header containing entry address, load address, and size packed in big-endian format.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input file, creates a header, and writes the header followed by the original file contents to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and invokes the header creation process; sets default addresses if not provided.
